precedence.rule: SD-01 owns frozen Core v1 product behavior; SD-14 owns accepted AI v1 product behavior. SD-14 opens AI as a separate phase and does not silently rewrite Core rules.
Domain/data/architecture within each document's approved scope. AI persistence rules in SD-16 must preserve Core relational invariants from SD-02/SD-03.
Public REST contract: SD-04 for Core v1, SD-17 for AI v1 target endpoints.
Core application/package architecture; SD-15 extends it for the AI domain without replacing frozen boundaries.
Core persistence implementation; AI persistence implementation follows SD-16.
Security and authentication baseline; AI authorization/privacy rules additionally come from SD-14/SD-15.
Core service orchestration; AI orchestration additionally follows SD-15.
Storage integration; AI indexing must continue to use the StorageService boundary.
Error and API failure contract; AI codes extend this contract through SD-17.
OpenAPI documentation baseline; AI endpoints must be added only when implemented and verified.
Required verification: SD-12 remains Core baseline and SD-18 adds AI-specific verification.
Implementation order only; neither execution plan may override product/design decisions.
